answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The knoll holds work receipts rather than names, so the mesa of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on time-locked work history, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
